translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the new moon of the ninth month, he visited the salt pools south of the desert.

sentences.zh: 壬午，至漠中，觀天鹽池。

translations.literal: On day rewu he reached the heart of the desert and viewed the Heavenly Salt Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On rewu day he reached the heart of the desert and viewed the Heavenly Salt Pool.

sentences.zh: 度漠北，之吐鹽池。

translations.literal: Crossing north of the desert, he went to the Spitting Salt Pool.
translations.idiomatic: He crossed north of the desert to the Spitting Salt Pool.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，南還長川。

translations.literal: On day guisi he returned south to Long River.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day he turned south to Long River.

sentences.zh: 丙申，臨觀長陂。

translations.literal: On day bingshen he came to view Long Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day he came to view Long Marsh.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On day gengshen in the tenth month of winter the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the tenth month the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 四年春二月，封皇子修為河間王，處文為長樂王，連為廣平王，黎為京兆王。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring in the fourth year the princes Xiu, Wenchang, Lian, and Li were enfeoffed as Princes of Hejian, Changle, Guangping, and Jingzhao respectively.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year he enfeoffed his sons Xiu as Prince of Hejian, Wenchang as Prince of Changle, Lian as Prince of Guangping, and Li as Prince of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，北巡，自參合陂東過蟠羊山，大雨，暴水流輜車數百乘，殺百餘人。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer he toured north; east from Canhe Marsh he passed Coiled Sheep Mountain; great rain fell and sudden floodwaters overturned several hundred supply wagons and killed more than a hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he toured north; east from Canhe Marsh a storm flood overturned hundreds of supply wagons and killed more than a hundred men.

sentences.zh: 遂東北逾石漠，至長川，幸濡源。

translations.literal: He then went northeast beyond Stone Desert to Long River and visited Ruyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He went northeast beyond Stone Desert to Long River and visited Ruyuan.

sentences.zh: 常山王遵有罪賜死。

translations.literal: Changshan Prince Zun was guilty and granted death.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zun of Changshan was found guilty and ordered to die.

sentences.zh: 六月，赫連屈丐自稱大單于、大夏天王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Helian Bobo styled himself Grand Chanyu and Great Heavenly King of Xia.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Helian Bobo declared himself Grand Chanyu and Great Heavenly King of Xia.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，西幸參合陂。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn he traveled west to Canhe Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he went west to Canhe Marsh.

sentences.zh: 築北宮垣，三旬而罷，乃還宮。

translations.literal: The northern palace wall was built; after thirty days the work was halted, and he then returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: He built the northern palace wall, finished in thirty days, and returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 慕容寶養子高雲殺慕容熙而自立，僭號天王。

translations.literal: Murong Bao's adopted son Gao Yun killed Murong Xi and set himself up, usurping the title Heavenly King.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yun, adopted son of Murong Bao, killed Murong Xi and declared himself Heavenly King.

sentences.zh: 八月，誅司空庾嶽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Minister of Works Yue was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Minister of Works Yue was put to death.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月，行幸豺山宮，遂如參合陂，觀漁于延水，至寧川。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the fifth year he traveled to Wolf Mountain Palace, then went to Canhe Marsh, watched fishing on the Yan River, and reached Ningchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year he went to Wolf Mountain Palace, then to Canhe Marsh, watched fishing on the Yan River, and reached Ningchuan.

sentences.zh: 三月，姚興遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the third month Yao Xing sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Yao Xing sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the seventh month of autumn, day wuxu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the new moon of the seventh month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，禿發傉檀僭即涼王位。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter Tufa Rutan usurped the title King of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Tufa Rutan declared himself King of Liang.

sentences.zh: 六年夏，帝不豫。

translations.literal: In the summer of the sixth year the Emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the sixth year the Emperor fell gravely ill.

sentences.zh: 初，帝服寒食散，自太醫令陰羌死後，藥數動發，至此愈甚。

translations.literal: Earlier the Emperor had taken cold-food powder; after Chief Physician Yin Qiang died the doses repeatedly provoked crises, and by now the attacks had grown far worse.
translations.idiomatic: He had long taken cold-food powder; after Chief Physician Yin Qiang died the doses brought on worse and worse crises.

sentences.zh: 而災變屢見，憂懣不安，或數日不食，或不寢達旦，歸咎群下，喜怒乖常。

translations.literal: Omens and strange events appeared again and again; anxious and unsettled, he sometimes went several days without eating, sometimes sat awake until dawn, blamed his ministers, and his joy and anger lost all constancy.
translations.idiomatic: Strange omens piled up; restless, he sometimes fasted for days, sometimes sat awake until dawn, blamed his officials, and turned erratic in temper.

sentences.zh: 謂百僚左右不可信，慮如天文之占，或有肘腋之虞。

translations.literal: He said the hundred officials and attendants at his side could not be trusted, fearing that, as the astronomical prognostications warned, treachery might strike at his very side.
translations.idiomatic: He said none of the officials around him could be trusted and feared the stars foretold treachery at his elbow.

sentences.zh: 追思既往成敗得失，終日竟夜獨語不止，若傍有鬼物對揚者。

translations.literal: Brooding on past successes, failures, gains, and losses, he talked to himself all day and all night without cease, as though ghostly beings stood beside him answering back.
translations.idiomatic: He brooded over past victories and defeats and talked to himself day and night as though someone unseen answered back.

sentences.zh: 朝臣至前，追其舊惡，便見殺害。

translations.literal: When courtiers came before him he would recall their old offenses and have them killed on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: When a courtier came before him he dredged up old wrongs and killed him at once.

sentences.zh: 其餘或以顏色變動，或以喘息不調，或以行步乖節，或以言辭失措，帝以為懷惡在心，變見於外，乃手自毆擊。

translations.literal: Others he killed because their color shifted, because their breathing faltered, because their gait broke rhythm, or because their words slipped; the Emperor believed malice lay in the heart and showed itself outwardly, and with his own hands he beat them.
translations.idiomatic: Others he killed for a change of expression, uneven breath, an awkward step, or a slip of the tongue, convinced their hearts were guilty and their bodies had betrayed them, and beat them to death himself.

sentences.zh: 死者皆陳天安殿前。

translations.literal: The dead were all displayed before the Hall of Heavenly Peace.
translations.idiomatic: The dead were laid out before the Hall of Heavenly Peace.

sentences.zh: 於是朝野人情各懷危懼，有司廢怠，莫相督攝，百工偷劫，盜賊公行，巷里之間，人為稀少。

translations.literal: Then court and countryside alike were filled with dread; officials grew slack and no one supervised another; craftsmen stole and plundered openly; thieves walked abroad; in the lanes and alleys people grew few.
translations.idiomatic: Court and countryside alike lived in fear; officials neglected their duties; craftsmen stole openly; thieves roamed the streets; the lanes grew empty.

sentences.zh: 帝亦聞之，曰：「朕故縱之使然，幸過災年，當更清整之耳。

translations.literal: The Emperor also heard of it and said: "I have deliberately let matters go this way; once the years of disaster pass, I shall put everything in order again."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor heard of it too and said he had let it go on purpose and would set things right once the bad years had passed.

sentences.zh: 」秋七月，慕容氏支屬百餘家謀欲外奔，發覺，伏誅死者三百餘人。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn more than a hundred households of the Murong clan kin plotted to flee abroad; when the plot was discovered, more than three hundred were executed after interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month more than a hundred Murong kinsmen plotted to flee; caught, more than three hundred were put to death.

sentences.zh: 八月，衛王儀謀叛，賜死。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Prince Yi of Wei plotted rebellion and was ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Prince Yi of Wei plotted rebellion and was sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 十月戊辰，清河王紹作亂，帝崩于天安殿，時年三十九。

translations.literal: On day wuchen in the tenth month Prince Shao of Qinghe made rebellion; the Emperor died in the Hall of Heavenly Peace at age thirty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day in the tenth month Prince Shao of Qinghe rose in rebellion; the Emperor died in the Hall of Heavenly Peace. He was thirty-nine.

sentences.zh: 永興二年九月甲寅，上諡曰宣武皇帝，葬于盛樂金陵，廟號太祖，泰常五年改諡曰道武。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day jiayin, of the second year of Yongxing the posthumous title Martial-Illustrious Emperor was granted; he was buried at Golden Tomb in Shengle; temple name Grand Founder; in the fifth year of Taichang the posthumous title was changed to Martial Way.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day in the ninth month of Yongxing year two he received the posthumous name Emperor Martial-Illustrious, was buried at the Golden Tomb at Shengle, and given temple name Grand Ancestor; in Taichang year five the posthumous title became Emperor Dao Wu.

sentences.zh: 太宗明元皇帝諱嗣，道武皇帝之長子也。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor, Emperor Mingyuan, personal name Si, was the eldest son of Emperor Dao Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Mingyuan, styled the Grand Ancestor, whose name was Si, was Dao Wu's eldest son.

sentences.zh: 母曰劉貴人，登國七年，生於雲中宮。

translations.literal: His mother was Lady Liu the Honored; in the seventh year of Dengguo he was born in the Cloud Palace.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Honored Lady Liu; in Dengguo year seven he was born at the Cloud Palace.

sentences.zh: 道武晚有男，聞而大悅，乃大赦。

translations.literal: Dao Wu had a son late in life; on hearing the news he rejoiced greatly and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Dao Wu had long awaited a son; when he heard, he rejoiced and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 帝明睿寬毅，非禮不動。

translations.literal: The Emperor was bright, wise, generous, and resolute; he would not act against propriety.
translations.idiomatic: He was clear-minded, wise, magnanimous, and firm; nothing moved him outside the rites.

sentences.zh: 天興六年，封齊王，拜相國。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tianxing he was enfeoffed Prince of Qi and appointed Chancellor of State.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianxing year six he was made Prince of Qi and Chancellor of State.

sentences.zh: 初，帝母既賜死，道武召帝告曰：「昔漢武將立其子而殺其母，不令婦人與國政，汝當繼統，故吾遠同漢武。

translations.literal: At the outset, after the Emperor's mother had been ordered to die, Dao Wu summoned the Emperor and said: "In old days Emperor Wu of Han was about to establish his son and therefore killed the mother, not allowing women a share in state affairs; you are to succeed to the throne, so I follow Han Wu in the distant past."
translations.idiomatic: When his mother had been put to death, Dao Wu called him in and said: "Emperor Wu of Han killed his son's mother before setting the boy on the throne, lest a woman hold the state. You will succeed me, so I have done as Han Wu did."

sentences.zh: 」帝素純孝，哀不自勝。

translations.literal: The Emperor had always been pure in filial piety; grief overwhelmed him beyond bearing.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had always been devoted; grief overwhelmed him.

sentences.zh: 道武怒。

translations.literal: Dao Wu was angry.
translations.idiomatic: Dao Wu grew angry.

sentences.zh: 帝還宮，哀不自止，道武知而又召帝。

translations.literal: The Emperor returned to the palace; grief would not cease; Dao Wu learned of it and summoned him again.
translations.idiomatic: He went back to the palace still weeping; when Dao Wu heard, he summoned him again.

sentences.zh: 帝欲入，左右諫，請待和解而進，帝從之。

translations.literal: The Emperor wished to enter; his attendants remonstrated, asking that he wait until feelings had eased before going in; the Emperor followed their advice.
translations.idiomatic: He started to go in; his attendants urged him to wait until tempers had cooled; he listened.

sentences.zh: 及元紹之逆，帝還而誅之。

translations.literal: When Prince Shao's rebellion came, the Emperor returned and had him executed.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Shao rebelled, the Emperor came back and put him to death.

sentences.zh: 永興元年冬十月壬午，皇帝即位，大赦改元，追尊皇妣為宣穆皇后。

translations.literal: On day renwu in the tenth month of winter in the first year of Yongxing the Emperor took the throne, proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the era name, and posthumously honored his mother as Empress Xuanmu.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the tenth month of Yongxing year one he took the throne, proclaimed amnesty and a new reign title, and honored his mother posthumously as Empress Xuanmu.

sentences.zh: 公卿大臣先罷歸第者，悉復登用之。

translations.literal: Grand dukes, ministers, and high officials who had earlier been dismissed to their residences were all reappointed.
translations.idiomatic: Every noble and minister who had been sent home was brought back to office.

sentences.zh: 詔南平公長孫嵩、北新侯安同對理人訟，簡賢任能。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Duke Changsun Song of Southern Peace and Marquis An Tong of Northern Xin to hear and settle people's lawsuits and select the worthy for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Duke Changsun Song of Southern Peace and Marquis An Tong of Northern Xin to judge cases and appoint worthy men.

sentences.zh: 是月，馮跋弑其主高雲，僭號天王，國號北燕。

translations.literal: That month Feng Ba killed his lord Gao Yun, usurped the title Heavenly King, and styled his state Northern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Feng Ba murdered his ruler Gao Yun, styled himself Heavenly King, and named his state Northern Yan.

sentences.zh: 閏十月丁亥，硃提王悅謀反，賜死。

translations.literal: In the intercalary tenth month on day dinghai Prince Yue of Zhuti plotted rebellion and was ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the intercalary tenth month Prince Yue of Zhuti plotted rebellion and was sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 詔都兵將軍山陽侯奚斤巡諸州，問人疾苦。

translations.literal: An edict ordered General of the Capital Armies Marquis Xi Jin of Shanyang to tour the provinces and inquire into the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered General Xi Jin, Marquis of Shanyang, to tour the provinces and hear the people's grievances.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，封衛王儀子良為南陽王，進陰平公列爵為王，改封高涼王樂真為平陽王。

translations.literal: On day wuxu in the twelfth month he enfeoffed Ziliang, son of Prince Yi of Wei, as Prince of Nanyang, advanced Duke Lie of Yinping to princely rank, and changed the title of Le Zhen, Prince of Gaoliang, to Prince of Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day in the twelfth month he made Ziliang, son of Prince Yi of Wei, Prince of Nanyang, raised Duke Lie of Yinping to prince, and changed Prince Le Zhen of Gaoliang to Prince of Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，帝始居西宮，禦天文殿。

translations.literal: On day jihai the Emperor first took residence in the Western Palace and held court in the Hall of Heavenly Astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day he moved into the Western Palace and held court in the Hall of Heavenly Astronomy.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕犯塞。

translations.literal: The Rouran raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The Rouran raided the border.

sentences.zh: 是歲，乞伏乾歸自稱秦王。

translations.literal: That year Qifu Gangui styled himself King of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: That year Qifu Gangui declared himself King of Qin.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲寅朔，詔南平公長孫嵩等北征蠕蠕，因留屯漠南。

translations.literal: On the new moon, day jiayin, of the first month of spring in the second year an edict ordered Duke Changsun Song of Southern Peace and others to campaign north against the Rouran and remain encamped south of the desert.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the first month in year two he sent Duke Changsun Song of Southern Peace north against the Rouran with orders to camp south of the desert.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，嵩等自大漠還，蠕蠕追圍之于牛川。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer Song and the others returned from the great desert; the Rouran pursued and surrounded them at Ox Stream.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Song returned from the desert; the Rouran caught them at Ox Stream and besieged them.

sentences.zh: 壬申，帝北伐，蠕蠕聞而遁走。

translations.literal: On day renshen the Emperor marched north; the Rouran heard and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the Emperor marched north; hearing of it, the Rouran withdrew.

sentences.zh: 車駕還幸參合陂。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage returned to favor Canhe Mound.
translations.idiomatic: The court returned to Canhe Mound.

sentences.zh: 六月，晉將劉裕滅慕容超。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Jin general Liu Yu destroyed Murong Chao.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Jin general Liu Yu destroyed Murong Chao.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，立射台於陂西，仍講武。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on day dingsi he erected an archery platform west of the mound and conducted martial exercises.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the seventh month he built an archery platform west of the mound and held a military review.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，至自北伐。

translations.literal: On day yichou he returned from the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day he returned from the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 三年春二月戊戌，詔簡宮人非禦及伎巧者，悉以賜鰥人。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring in the third year on day wuxu an edict ordered selection of palace women not in imperial service or skilled in arts; all were given to widowers.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day in the second month of year three he ordered palace women not needed at court or for crafts given to widowers.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔北新侯安同等持節巡行並、定二州及諸山居雜胡、丁零，問其疾苦，察舉守宰不法者。

translations.literal: On day jihai an edict ordered Marquis An Tong of Northern Xin and others, bearing credentials, to tour Bing and Ding provinces and the mountain-dwelling mixed Hu and Dingling tribes, inquire into their hardships, and expose unlawful prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day he ordered Marquis An Tong of Northern Xin, with full authority, to tour Bing and Ding provinces and the mountain tribes, hear their grievances, and impeach corrupt officials.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，簡宮人工伎之不急者出，賜人不能自存者。

translations.literal: On day xinchou palace women whose crafts were not urgently needed were selected out and given to those who could not support themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day he released unneeded craftswomen from the palace and gave them to people who could not support themselves.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，詔侍臣常佩劍。

translations.literal: In the third month on day jiwei an edict ordered attendant ministers to wear swords at all times.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day in the third month he ordered ministers in attendance to wear swords at all times.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙寅，復出宮人賜鰥人。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer on day bingyin he again released palace women and gave them to widowers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the fifth month he again gave palace women to widowers.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，車駕謁金陵于盛樂。

translations.literal: On day dingmao the imperial carriage visited Golden Tomb at Shengle.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the court visited the Golden Tomb at Shengle.

sentences.zh: 己巳，昌黎王慕容伯兒謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On day jisi Prince Murong Bo'er of Changli plotted rebellion and was executed where he lay.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Prince Murong Bo'er of Changli plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 六月，姚興遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Yao Xing sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Yao Xing sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，賜衛士酺三日。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on day wushen the guards were granted communal feasting for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day in the seventh month he granted the guards three days of feasting.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丁未，大閱於東郊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter on day dingwei a great muster was held at the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day in the eleventh month he held a great review at the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 四年春二月癸未，登獸圈，射猛獸。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring in the fourth year on day guiwei he ascended the beast pens and shot fierce animals.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day in the second month of year four he climbed into the hunting park and shot wild beasts.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，宴群臣於西宮，使各獻直言，勿有所諱。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on day yiwei he feasted the ministers in the Western Palace and had each offer blunt counsel without reserve.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day in the fourth month he feasted his ministers in the Western Palace and asked each to speak plainly without holding back.

sentences.zh: 六月，乞伏乾歸為兄子公府所弑。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Qifu Gangui was murdered by his elder brother's son Gongfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Qifu Gangui was murdered by his nephew Gongfu.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙辰，大閱於東郊。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on day bingchen a great muster was held at the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the intercalary month he held a great review at the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳朔，東巡。

translations.literal: On the new moon, day jisi, of the seventh month of autumn he toured east.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the seventh month he toured east.

sentences.zh: 置四廂大將，又放十二時，置十二小將。

translations.literal: He established four great generals of the cardinal wards and also set the twelve watches, establishing twelve lesser generals.
translations.idiomatic: He appointed four senior generals for the cardinal divisions and twelve junior generals for the twelve watches.

sentences.zh: 以山陽侯奚斤、元城公屈行左右丞相。

translations.literal: Marquis Xi Jin of Shanyang and Duke Qu Xing of Yuancheng were made left and right chancellors.
translations.idiomatic: He made Marquis Xi Jin of Shanyang and Duke Qu Xing of Yuancheng left and right chancellors.

sentences.zh: 己卯，大獼于石會山。

translations.literal: On day jimao a great hunt was held at Stone Meeting Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day he held a great hunt at Stone Meeting Mountain.

sentences.zh: 戊子，臨去畿陂觀漁。

translations.literal: On day wuzi he came to the Ji Mound by the waters and watched the fishing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day he watched the fishing at the Ji Mound.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，至於濡源，西巡，幸北部諸落。

translations.literal: On day gengyin he reached Ruyuan, toured west, and favored the tribes of the northern regions.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day he reached Ruyuan, turned west, and visited the northern tribes.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，幸西宮，臨板殿，大饗群臣，命百姓大酺三日。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on day renzi he favored the Western Palace, came to the Plank Hall, held a great feast for the ministers, and ordered the people a grand communal drinking for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in the eighth month he went to the Western Palace, feasted his ministers at the Plank Hall, and ordered three days of public celebration.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜王公以下至宿衛將士布各有差。

translations.literal: On day yimao princes, dukes, and all down to the night-watch generals and soldiers were granted cloth in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day he gave graded gifts of cloth to princes, officials, and garrison troops alike.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己丑，賜宗室近屬南陽王良以下至於緦麻親布帛各有差。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter on day jichou members of the imperial clan from Prince Liang of Nanyang down to distant kin in the finest hemp mourning grade were granted cloth and silk in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day in the eleventh month he gave graded gifts of cloth and silk to the imperial clan from Prince Liang of Nanyang down to even the most distant kin.

sentences.zh: 是月，沮渠蒙遜僭稱河西王。

translations.literal: That month Juqu Mengxun usurped the title Prince of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: That month Juqu Mengxun styled himself Prince of Hexi.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，北巡，至長城而旋。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on day dingsi he toured north, reached the Great Wall, and turned back.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the twelfth month he toured north to the Great Wall and returned.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月己巳，大閱畿內，男年十二以上悉集。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the fifth year on day jisi a great muster was held within the capital domain; all males twelve and above were gathered.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day in the first month of year five he mustered the capital domain; every male twelve or older was called up.

sentences.zh: 己卯，幸西宮。

translations.literal: On day jimao he favored the Western Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day he went to the Western Palace.

sentences.zh: 頞拔大渠帥四十餘人詣闕奉貢，賜以繒帛錦罽各有差。

translations.literal: More than forty chieftains of the great canals of Eba came to court with tribute and were granted silk, brocade, and felt in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: More than forty chiefs of Eba came to court with tribute and received graded gifts of silk and brocade.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔諸州，六十戶出戎馬一匹。

translations.literal: On day yiyou an edict ordered each province to supply one war horse for every sixty households.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day he ordered every province to furnish one war horse per sixty households.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大閱於東郊，署將帥，以山陽侯奚斤為前軍，眾三萬；

translations.literal: On day gengyin a great muster was held at the eastern suburb; commanders were appointed; Marquis Xi Jin of Shanyang was made vanguard with thirty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day he held a great review at the eastern suburb and appointed commanders; Marquis Xi Jin of Shanyang led the vanguard with thirty thousand men.

sentences.zh: 陽平王熙等十二將各一萬騎；

translations.literal: Prince Xi of Yangping and twelve other generals each had ten thousand horsemen;
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xi of Yangping and twelve other generals each commanded ten thousand cavalry.

sentences.zh: 帝臨白登，躬自校覽。

translations.literal: The Emperor came to White Mount and personally inspected them.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor went to White Mount and inspected the troops himself.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，幸高柳川。

translations.literal: In the second month on day gengxu he favored Gaoliu Stream.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day in the second month he went to Gaoliu Stream.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，穿魚池于北苑。

translations.literal: On day guichou a fish pond was dug in the northern park.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day he dug a fish pond in the northern park.

sentences.zh: 庚午，姚興遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On day gengwu Yao Xing sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Yao Xing sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔使者巡行天下，招延俊彥，搜揚隱逸。

translations.literal: On day jimao an edict ordered envoys to tour the realm, summon outstanding talent, and search out recluses.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day he sent envoys through the realm to seek worthy men and hidden scholars.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，西巡。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on day yimao he toured west.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day in the fourth month he toured west.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，行幸雲中舊宮之大室。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on day yihai he traveled to favor the great hall of the old palace at Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the fifth month he visited the great hall of the old palace at Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大赦。

translations.literal: On day bingzi a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day he proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 六月，西幸五原，校獵于骨羅山，獲獸十萬。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he favored the west at Wuyuan, conducted a hunting review at Mount Guluow, and took a hundred thousand beasts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he went west to Wuyuan, hunted at Mount Guluow, and took a hundred thousand animals.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，還幸薄山。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on day jisi he returned to favor Bo Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day in the seventh month he returned to Bo Mountain.

sentences.zh: 帝登觀宣武游幸刻石頌德之處，乃於其旁起石壇而薦饗焉，賜從者大酺於山下。

translations.literal: The Emperor climbed to view the place where Martial-Illustrious had toured and set up carved stone praising virtue; beside it he raised a stone altar and offered sacrifices, granting those who followed a great communal feast at the foot of the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: He climbed to the spot where Emperor Martial-Illustrious had carved his praises in stone, built an altar beside it and made offerings, and feasted his followers at the foot of the hill.

sentences.zh: 前軍奚斤等破越勒倍泥部落於跋那山西，徙二萬餘家而旋。

translations.literal: The vanguard Xi Jin and others defeated the Yuele Beini tribe west of Mount Bana, relocated more than twenty thousand households, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Vanguard Xi Jin defeated the Yuele Beini west of Mount Bana, resettled more than twenty thousand households, and returned.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，車駕自大室西南巡諸部落，遂南次定襄大洛城，東逾七嶺山，田於善無川。

translations.literal: On day bingxu the imperial carriage from the great hall toured southwest among the tribes, then encamped south at Dingxiang Daluo City, crossed east over Seven Ridges Mountain, and farmed at Shanyou Stream.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the court left the great hall, toured the tribes southwest, camped south at Dingxiang Daluo City, crossed Seven Ridges east, and tilled fields at Shanyou Stream.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on day guimao the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day in the eighth month the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，奚斤等班師。

translations.literal: On day guichou Xi Jin and the others returned with the army in order.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Xi Jin and his army returned in triumph.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，帝臨白登山，觀降人，數軍實。

translations.literal: On day jiayin the Emperor came to White Mount, viewed the surrendered people, and counted military stores.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor went to White Mount, reviewed the captives, and counted the stores of arms.

sentences.zh: 置新人于大寧，給農器，計口受田。

translations.literal: New people were settled in Daning; farm tools were given; land was allotted by head count.
translations.idiomatic: He settled the new captives in Daning, gave them farm tools, and allotted land by head.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸酉，大饗於西宮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter on day guiyou a great feast was held in the Western Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day in the eleventh month he held a great feast in the Western Palace.

sentences.zh: 姚興遣使朝貢，請進女，帝許之。

translations.literal: Yao Xing sent envoys with tribute and asked to present a daughter; the Emperor consented.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing sent tribute envoys and asked to send a daughter; the Emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 神瑞元年春正月辛酉，以禎瑞頻集，大赦改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the first year of Shenrui on day xinyou, because auspicious omens had gathered repeatedly, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the first month of Shenrui year one, frequent auspicious signs moved him to proclaim amnesty and change the reign title.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，行幸繁畤。

translations.literal: On day xinsi he traveled to favor Fanzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day he went to Fanzhi.

sentences.zh: 賜王公以下至於士卒百工布帛各有差。

translations.literal: Princes, dukes, and all down to soldiers and the hundred crafts were granted cloth and silk in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: He gave graded gifts of cloth and silk to princes, soldiers, and artisans alike.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the second month on day wuxu the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day in the second month the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，起豐宮于平城東北。

translations.literal: On day yimao Feng Palace was raised northeast of Pingcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day he began Feng Palace northeast of Pingcheng.

sentences.zh: 夏六月，乞伏熾盤滅禿發傉檀。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer Qifu Chipan destroyed Tufa Rutan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Qifu Chipan destroyed Tufa Rutan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，晉將硃齡石滅蜀。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn the Jin general Zhu Lingshi destroyed Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Jin general Zhu Lingshi conquered Shu.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，詔馬邑侯元陋孫使于姚興。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on day wuzi an edict ordered Marquis Yuan Lousun of Mayi to go as envoy to Yao Xing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day in the eighth month he sent Marquis Yuan Lousun of Mayi as envoy to Yao Xing.

sentences.zh: 姚興遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Yao Xing sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the new moon, day dingsi, of the ninth month there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the ninth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬午，詔使者巡行諸州，校閱守宰資財，非自家所齎，悉簿為贓。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter on day renwu an edict ordered envoys to tour the provinces, audit the wealth of prefects and magistrates, and register all not brought from their own families as stolen goods.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the eleventh month he sent envoys to audit provincial officials' wealth; anything not brought from home was entered as embezzlement.

sentences.zh: 守宰不如法，聽百姓詣闕告之。

translations.literal: Prefects and magistrates who did not follow the law were to be reported by the people coming to court.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who broke the law could be reported by the people at court.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌朔，蠕蠕犯塞。

translations.literal: On the new moon, day bingxu, of the twelfth month the Rouran raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the twelfth month the Rouran raided the border.

sentences.zh: 丙申，車駕北伐。

translations.literal: On day bingshen the imperial carriage marched north on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the court marched north on campaign.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙辰，車駕至自北伐。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the second year on day bingchen the imperial carriage arrived from the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the first month of year two the court returned from the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，大饗於西宮。

translations.literal: In the second month on day dinghai a great feast was held in the Western Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the second month he held a great feast in the Western Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，立宣武廟于白登西。

translations.literal: On day jiachen the Temple of Martial-Illustrious was established west of White Mount.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day he founded the Temple of Martial-Illustrious west of White Mount.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，詔以刺史守宰率多逋惰，今年貲調縣違者，謫出家財以充，不聽徵發於人。

translations.literal: In the third month on day dingchou an edict stated that because provincial inspectors and prefects and magistrates were mostly remiss and lazy, for this year's land tax and corvée levies any county in default must make good from the officials' household wealth, with no levying upon the people permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day in the third month he ruled that lazy officials must pay shortfalls in land tax and corvée from their own estates, not from the people.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，晉人來聘。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer Jin envoys came on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month envoys from Jin came on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 己卯，北巡。

translations.literal: On day jimao he toured north.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day he toured north.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，次於參合，東幸大寧。

translations.literal: On dinghai day in the fifth month he halted at Canhe and traveled east to favor Daning.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the fifth month he stopped at Canhe and went east to Daning.

sentences.zh: 丁未，田於四岬山。

translations.literal: On dingwei day he farmed at Four Cape Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day he tilled fields at Four Cape Mountain.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，臨去畿陂觀漁。

translations.literal: On wuwu day in the sixth month he went to Quji Mound to watch the fishing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the sixth month he watched the fishing at Quji Mound.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，次於濡源，立蜯台。

translations.literal: On xinyou day he halted at Ruyuan and erected Clam Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day he stopped at Ruyuan and built Clam Terrace.

sentences.zh: 遂射白熊于頹牛山，獲之。

translations.literal: He then shot a white bear on Tui Ox Mountain and took it.
translations.idiomatic: He shot a white bear on Tui Ox Mountain and brought it down.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，幸赤城，親見長老，問人疾苦，復租一年。

translations.literal: On dingmao day he favored Chicheng, personally received the elders, inquired into the people's hardships, and remitted one year's land tax.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day he went to Chicheng, met the elders in person, asked after the people's hardships, and remitted a full year of land tax.

sentences.zh: 南次石亭，幸上穀，問百年，訪賢俊，復田租之半。

translations.literal: He halted south at Shiting, favored Shanggu, inquired of centenarians, sought out worthy talent, and remitted half the field tax.
translations.idiomatic: He stopped south at Shiting, visited Shanggu, questioned centenarians, sought worthy men, and cut the field tax in half.

sentences.zh: 壬申，幸涿鹿，登嶠山，觀溫泉，使乙太牢祠黃帝、唐堯廟。

translations.literal: On renshen day he favored Zhuolu, climbed Qiao Mountain, viewed the hot springs, and sent an ox offering to sacrifice at the temples of the Yellow Emperor and Tang Yao.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day he went to Zhuolu, climbed Qiao Mountain, viewed the hot springs, and had an ox sacrifice offered at the temples of the Yellow Emperor and Tang Yao.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，幸廣寧，事如上穀。

translations.literal: On guiyou day he favored Guangning and did as at Shanggu.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day he visited Guangning and did as he had at Shanggu.

sentences.zh: 己卯，登廣寧之曆山，乙太牢祠舜廟，帝親加禮焉。

translations.literal: On jimao day he climbed Li Mountain in Guangning, sent an ox offering to sacrifice at Shun's temple, and the Emperor personally added ritual honor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day he climbed Li Mountain in Guangning, offered an ox at Shun's temple, and the Emperor himself performed the rites.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，幸代。

translations.literal: On gengchen day he favored Dai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day he went to Dai.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，車駕還宮，復所過田租之半。

translations.literal: On guiwei day in the seventh month of autumn the imperial carriage returned to the palace and remitted half the field tax along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day in the seventh month the court returned to the palace and halved the field tax everywhere it had passed.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰晦，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the last day of the eighth month, gengchen day, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: At month's end on gengchen day in the eighth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 九月，京師人饑，聽就食山東。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the capital was hungry; people were permitted to go east to Shandong for food.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month famine struck the capital; people were allowed to go east to Shandong to find food.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬子，姚興使奉其西平公主至，帝以後禮納之。

translations.literal: On renzi day in the tenth month of winter Yao Xing's envoys presented his Princess of Xiping; the Emperor received her with empress rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in the tenth month Yao Xing's envoys brought his Princess of Xiping; the Emperor welcomed her with the rites due an empress.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，行幸沮洳城。

translations.literal: On xinyou day he traveled to favor Juru City.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day he went to Juru City.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On guihai day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔以頻遇霜旱，年穀不登，命出布帛倉穀以振貧窮。

translations.literal: On bingyin day an edict stated that because of repeated frost and drought the year's grain had failed, and ordered disbursement from stores of cloth, silk, and grain to relieve the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day he ruled that repeated frost and drought had ruined the harvest and ordered cloth, silk, and grain from the stores given to the poor.

sentences.zh: 泰常元年春二月丁未，姚興死。

translations.literal: On dingwei day in the second month of spring in the first year of Taichang Yao Xing died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day in the second month of Taichang year one Yao Xing died.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，長樂王處文薨。

translations.literal: On jichou day in the third month Prince Changle Wang Chuwen died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day in the third month Prince Changle Wang Chuwen died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，大赦改元。

translations.literal: On renzi day in the fourth month of summer a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in the fourth month he proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 庚申，河間王修薨。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Prince Hejian Wang Xiu died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Prince Hejian Wang Xiu died.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，彗星二見。

translations.literal: On jiashen day in the fifth month two comets appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day in the fifth month two comets were seen.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，北巡。

translations.literal: On dingsi day in the sixth month he toured north.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the sixth month he toured north.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，大獮于牛川，登釜山，臨殷繁水，南觀於九十九泉。

translations.literal: On jiashen day in the seventh month of autumn a great hunt was held at Ox Stream; he climbed Kettle Mountain, overlooked the Yinfan River, and viewed the south from Ninety-Nine Springs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day in the seventh month he held a great hunt at Ox Stream, climbed Kettle Mountain, looked down on the Yinfan River, and gazed south from Ninety-Nine Springs.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On wuxu day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛亥晦，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the last day, xinhai, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: At month's end on xinhai day there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 九月，晉劉裕溯河伐姚泓，遣部將王仲德從陸道至梁城。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Jin general Liu Yu advanced upriver against Yao Hong and sent his subordinate Wang Zhongde by land route to Liangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Liu Yu of Jin marched upriver against Yao Hong and sent Wang Zhongde by land to Liangcheng.

sentences.zh: 兗州刺史尉建畏懦，棄守北渡，仲德遂入滑台。

translations.literal: The Yanzhou inspector Wei Jian was cowardly, abandoned his post and fled north across the river; Zhongde then entered Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Jian, inspector of Yanzhou, lost his nerve, abandoned his post, and fled north across the river; Zhongde then took Huatai.

sentences.zh: 詔將軍叔孫建等度河曜威，斬尉建於城下。

translations.literal: An edict ordered General Shusun Jian and others to cross the river and display might; Wei Jian was beheaded below the walls.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered General Shusun Jian and others to cross the river and show their strength; Wei Jian was beheaded beneath the walls.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊寅，起蓬台于北苑。

translations.literal: On wuyin day in the eleventh month of winter Peng Terrace was raised in the northern park.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day in the eleventh month he built Peng Terrace in the northern park.

sentences.zh: 十二月，南陽王良薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Prince Nanyang Wang Liang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Prince Nanyang Wang Liang died.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲戌朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the new moon, jiaxu day, of the first month of spring in the second year there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the first month in year two there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午，詔使者巡行天下，觀風俗，問其所苦。

translations.literal: On bingwu day in the second month an edict ordered envoys to tour the realm, observe customs, and inquire into hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day in the second month he sent envoys through the realm to observe local customs and hear what troubled the people.

sentences.zh: 是月，涼武昭王薨。

translations.literal: That month the Liang Martial-Illustrious King died.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Liang Martial-Illustrious King died.

sentences.zh: 五月，西巡至雲中，遂濟河，田於大漠。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he toured west to Yunzhong, crossed the river, and farmed in the great desert.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he went west to Yunzhong, crossed the river, and tilled fields in the great desert.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On yihai day in the seventh month of autumn the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the seventh month the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，起白台于城南，高二十丈。

translations.literal: On yiyou day White Terrace was raised south of the city, twenty zhang high.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day he built White Terrace south of the city, twenty zhang tall.

sentences.zh: 是月，晉劉裕滅姚泓。

translations.literal: That month the Jin general Liu Yu destroyed Yao Hong.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liu Yu of Jin destroyed Yao Hong.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，豫章王夔薨。

translations.literal: On guichou day in the tenth month of winter Prince Yuzhang Wang Kui died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day in the tenth month Prince Yuzhang Wang Kui died.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，詔河東、河內購泓子弟播越人間者。

translations.literal: On jiyou day in the twelfth month an edict ordered purchase in Hedong and Henei of Hong's kinsmen scattered among the people.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day in the twelfth month he ordered that in Hedong and Henei any of Hong's kin still living among the people be sought out and redeemed.

sentences.zh: 三年春三月，晉人來聘。

translations.literal: In the third month of spring in the third year envoys from Jin came on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year three envoys from Jin came on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，幸西宮。

translations.literal: On gengxu day he favored the Western Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day he went to the Western Palace.

sentences.zh: 以勃海、范陽郡去年水，復其租稅。

translations.literal: Because Bohai and Fanyang commanderies had suffered flood the previous year, their land tax and levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Bohai and Fanyang had flooded the year before; their taxes and levies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳，徙冀、定、幽三州徒何于京師。

translations.literal: On jisi day in the fourth month of summer the Tuohe people of Ji, Ding, and You provinces were moved to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day in the fourth month the Tuohe of Ji, Ding, and You provinces were relocated to the capital.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，東巡至濡源，及甘松。

translations.literal: On renzi day in the fifth month he toured east to Ruyuan and Gan Song.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in the fifth month he toured east as far as Ruyuan and Gan Song.

sentences.zh: 遣征東將軍長孫道生帥師襲馮跋，遂至龍城，徙其居人萬餘家而還。

translations.literal: He sent the eastern campaign general Changsun Daosheng to lead troops against Feng Ba; they reached Longcheng, moved more than ten thousand households of residents, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Eastern Campaign General Changsun Daosheng against Feng Ba; Daosheng reached Longcheng, resettled more than ten thousand households, and returned.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，車駕至京師。

translations.literal: On wuwu day in the seventh month of autumn the imperial carriage reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the seventh month the court reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 八月，雁門、河內大雨水，復其租稅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Yanmen and Henei had great rain and flood; their taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Yanmen and Henei were struck by heavy rain and flood; their taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，築宮於西苑。

translations.literal: On wuchen day in the tenth month of winter a palace was built in the western park.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day in the tenth month he built a palace in the western park.

sentences.zh: 十一月，赫連屈丐克長安。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Helian Quban captured Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Helian Quban took Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 十二月，晉安帝殂。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Emperor An of Jin died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Emperor An of Jin died.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬辰朔，車駕臨河，大蒐於犢渚。

translations.literal: On the new moon, renchen day, of the first month of spring in the fourth year the imperial carriage came to the river and held a great hunt at Calf Ford.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the first month in year four the court came to the river and held a great hunt at Calf Ford.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，還宮。

translations.literal: On guimao day he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 三月，赫連屈丐僭即皇帝位。

translations.literal: In the third month Helian Quban usurped the title of emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Helian Quban styled himself emperor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，築宮於蓬臺北。

translations.literal: On guichou day a palace was built north of Peng Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day he built a palace north of Peng Terrace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，享東廟，遠蕃助祭者數百國。

translations.literal: On gengchen day in the fourth month of summer he performed sacrifice at the eastern temple; several hundred distant tributary states assisted in the rites.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day in the fourth month he sacrificed at the eastern temple, with several hundred distant states joining the rites.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，南巡，幸雁門，賜所過無出今年租賦。

translations.literal: On xinsi day he toured south, favored Yanmen, and granted that along the route no one need pay this year's land tax and levies.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day he toured south to Yanmen and exempted the route from this year's land tax and levies.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅朔，觀漁于氵壘水。

translations.literal: On the new moon, gengyin day, of the fifth month he watched the fishing at Lei River.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the fifth month he watched the fishing at Lei River.

sentences.zh: 己亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On jihai day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛未，東巡，遣使祠恆嶽。

translations.literal: On xinwei day in the eighth month of autumn he toured east and sent envoys to sacrifice at Mount Heng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day in the eighth month he toured east and sent envoys to offer sacrifice at Mount Heng.

sentences.zh: 甲申，車駕還宮，賜所過無出今年田租。

translations.literal: On jiashen day the imperial carriage returned to the palace and granted that along the route no one need pay this year's field tax.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the court returned to the palace and exempted the route from this year's field tax.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，築宮于白登山。

translations.literal: On jiayin day in the ninth month a palace was built on White Ascent Mount.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day in the ninth month he built a palace on White Ascent Mount.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丁亥朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the new moon, dinghai day, of the eleventh month of winter there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eleventh month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，西巡，至雲中，逾白道，北獵野馬於辱孤山。

translations.literal: On guihai day in the twelfth month he toured west to Yunzhong, crossed White Road, and hunted wild horses north at Humiliated Solitary Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day in the twelfth month he went west to Yunzhong, crossed White Road, and hunted wild horses north at Humiliated Solitary Mountain.

sentences.zh: 至於黃河，從君子津西度，大狩于薛林山。

translations.literal: He reached the Yellow River, crossed west from Gentleman Ford, and held a great hunt at Xue Forest Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: He came to the Yellow River, crossed west from Gentleman Ford, and held a great hunt at Xue Forest Mountain.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丙戌朔，自薛林東還。

translations.literal: On the new moon, bingxu day, of the first month of spring in the fifth year he returned east from Xue Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the first month in year five he turned east from Xue Forest.

sentences.zh: 至屋竇城，饗勞將士，大酺二日，班禽以賜之。

translations.literal: At Wudi City he feasted and rewarded the officers and soldiers, held a grand communal drinking for two days, and distributed game in gift.
translations.idiomatic: At Wudi City he feasted and rewarded his officers and men, held two days of public celebration, and gave out game as gifts.

sentences.zh: 己亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On jihai day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，南陽王意文薨。

translations.literal: On bingxu day in the third month Prince Nanyang Wang Yiwen died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the third month Prince Nanyang Wang Yiwen died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，起氵壘南宮。

translations.literal: On bingyin day in the fourth month of summer Lei South Palace was begun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the fourth month he began Lei South Palace.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，詔曰：「宣武皇帝體得一之玄遠，應自然之沖妙，大行大名，未盡盛美。

translations.literal: On yiyou day in the fifth month an edict stated: "Emperor Xuanwu embodied the profound remoteness of obtaining the One, responded to the unadorned subtlety of nature; his great conduct and great name did not fully exhaust his supreme excellence.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day in the fifth month he proclaimed: "Emperor Xuanwu grasped the deep mystery of the One and answered to nature's plain subtlety; yet his great deeds and great fame did not wholly show his full glory.

sentences.zh: 今啟緯圖，始睹尊號，其更上尊諡曰道武皇帝，以章靈命之先啟，聖德之玄同。

translations.literal: Now that the celestial pattern has opened, we first behold his honored title; let his posthumous epithet be raised further to Emperor Dao Wu, to manifest how the numinous mandate first arose and how sage virtue matched the mystery."
translations.idiomatic: Now the charts of heaven are revealed and we see his true title at last: let his posthumous name be raised to Emperor Dao Wu, that the first stirring of the sacred mandate and the hidden sameness of sage virtue may be made plain."

sentences.zh: 」庚戌，淮南侯司馬國璠、池陽侯司馬道賜等謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On gengxu day the Marquis of Huainan Sima Guofan, the Marquis of Chiyang Sima Daoci, and others plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Sima Guofan, Marquis of Huainan, Sima Daoci, Marquis of Chiyang, and others plotted rebellion and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，幸翳犢山。

translations.literal: On bingyin day in the sixth month he favored Yiyi Calf Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the sixth month he went to Yiyi Calf Mountain.

sentences.zh: 是月，晉恭帝禪位於宋。

translations.literal: That month Emperor Gong of Jin abdicated to Song.
translations.idiomatic: That month Emperor Gong of Jin abdicated in favor of Song.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，西至五原。

translations.literal: On dingyou day in the seventh month of autumn he went west to Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day in the seventh month he went west to Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，幸雲中大室，賜從者大酺。

translations.literal: On dingwei day he favored the Great Hall at Yunzhong and granted his followers a grand communal drinking.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day he visited the Great Hall at Yunzhong and gave his followers a great public feast.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On guihai day in the eighth month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day in the eighth month the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲午，陰平王烈薨。

translations.literal: On jiawu day in the intercalary month Prince Yinping Wang Lie died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day in the intercalary month Prince Yinping Wang Lie died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西涼亡。

translations.literal: That year Western Liang perished.
translations.idiomatic: That year Western Liang fell.

sentences.zh: 六年春二月己亥，詔天下戶二十輸戎馬一匹、大牛一頭。

translations.literal: On jihai day in the second month of spring in the sixth year an edict ordered that for every twenty households in the realm one war horse and one great ox were to be furnished.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the second month of year six he ordered every twenty households to supply one war horse and one great ox.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，陽平王熙薨。

translations.literal: On jiazi day in the third month Prince Yangping Wang Xi died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day in the third month Prince Yangping Wang Xi died.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，制六部人羊滿百口者調戎馬一匹。

translations.literal: On yihai day a regulation was set that among the six divisions, households with a hundred sheep or more owed one war horse in levy.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day he ruled that in the six divisions any household with a hundred sheep or more owed one war horse.

sentences.zh: 發京師六千餘人築苑，起自舊苑，東苞白登，周回四十餘里。

translations.literal: More than six thousand men from the capital were sent to build a park, starting from the old park, enclosing White Ascent to the east, more than forty li in circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He sent more than six thousand men from the capital to build a park from the old grounds east around White Ascent, more than forty li around.

sentences.zh: 夏六月乙酉，北巡，至於蟠羊山。

translations.literal: On yiyou day in the sixth month of summer he toured north to Coiled Goat Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day in the sixth month he toured north to Coiled Goat Mountain.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On yimao day in the seventh month of autumn the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day in the seventh month the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，西巡。

translations.literal: On guiyou day he toured west.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day he toured west.

sentences.zh: 獵於祚山，親射猛獸，獲之。

translations.literal: He hunted at Zuo Mountain, personally shot fierce beasts, and took them.
translations.idiomatic: He hunted at Zuo Mountain, shot fierce beasts himself, and brought them down.

sentences.zh: 遂至於河。

translations.literal: He then reached the river.
translations.idiomatic: He then came to the river.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，大獼於犢渚。

translations.literal: On gengzi day in the eighth month a great hunt was held at Calf Ford.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the eighth month he held a great hunt at Calf Ford.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On gengxu day in the ninth month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day in the ninth month the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 壬申，宋人來聘。

translations.literal: On renshen day envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥，行幸代。

translations.literal: On jihai day in the tenth month of winter he traveled to favor Dai.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the tenth month he went to Dai.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，西巡於雲中。

translations.literal: On bingshen day in the twelfth month he toured west in Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day in the twelfth month he toured west through Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲辰朔，自雲中西幸屋竇城，賜從者大酺三日。

translations.literal: On the new moon, jiachen day, of the first month of spring in the seventh year he traveled west from Yunzhong to favor Wudi City and granted his followers three days of grand communal drinking.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the first month in year seven he went west from Yunzhong to Wudi City and gave his followers three days of public celebration.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On bingxu day in the second month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the second month the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，河南王曜薨。

translations.literal: On yichou day in the third month Prince Henan Wang Yao died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day in the third month Prince Henan Wang Yao died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，封皇子燾為太平王，拜相國，加大將軍；

translations.literal: On jiaxu day in the fourth month of summer the imperial son Tao was enfeoffed as Prince of Taiping, appointed Chancellor of State, and promoted to Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the fourth month he made his son Tao Prince of Taiping, Chancellor of State, and Grand General.

sentences.zh: 丕為樂平王，加車騎大將軍；

translations.literal: Pi was enfeoffed as Prince of Leping and appointed Cavalry-and-Chariots Grand General;
translations.idiomatic: Pi was made Prince of Leping and named Cavalry-and-Chariots Grand General;

sentences.zh: 彌為安定王，加衛大將軍；

translations.literal: Mi was enfeoffed as Prince of Anding and appointed Guard Grand General;
translations.idiomatic: Mi was made Prince of Anding and named Guard Grand General;

sentences.zh: 范為樂安王，加中軍大將軍；

translations.literal: Fan was enfeoffed as Prince of Le'an and appointed Central Army Grand General;
translations.idiomatic: Fan was made Prince of Le'an and named Central Army Grand General;

sentences.zh: 健為永昌王，加撫軍大將軍；

translations.literal: Jian was enfeoffed as Prince of Yongchang and appointed Pacification Army Grand General;
translations.idiomatic: Jian was made Prince of Yongchang and named Pacification Army Grand General;

sentences.zh: 崇為建甯王，加輔國大將軍；

translations.literal: Chong was enfeoffed as Prince of Jianning and appointed Auxiliating-the-State Grand General;
translations.idiomatic: Chong was made Prince of Jianning and named Auxiliating-the-State Grand General;

sentences.zh: 俊為新興王，加鎮軍大將軍；

translations.literal: Jun was enfeoffed as Prince of Xinxing and appointed Suppression Army Grand General;
translations.idiomatic: Jun was made Prince of Xinxing and named Suppression Army Grand General;

sentences.zh: 獻懷長公主子嵇敬為長樂王，拜大司馬、大將軍。

translations.literal: Ji Jing, son of Princess Xianhuai, was enfeoffed as Prince of Changle and appointed Grand Marshal and Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Jing, son of Princess Xianhuai, was made Prince of Changle, Grand Marshal, and Grand General.

sentences.zh: 初，帝服寒食散，頻年發動，不堪萬機，五月，立太平王燾為皇太子，臨朝聽政。

translations.literal: Earlier the Emperor had taken cold-food powder; year after year it flared up and he could not bear the myriad affairs of state. In the fifth month he installed Prince Taiping Tao as crown prince to preside over court and hear government.
translations.idiomatic: From the first the Emperor had used cold-food powder; it seized him year after year until he could no longer manage the realm. In the fifth month he made Prince Taiping Tao crown prince to hold court and govern.

sentences.zh: 是月，宋武帝殂。

translations.literal: That month Emperor Wu of Song died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Emperor Wu of Song died.

sentences.zh: 秋九月，詔司空奚斤等帥師伐宋。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn an edict ordered Minister of Works Xi Jin and others to lead troops against Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn he ordered Minister of Works Xi Jin and others to march against Song.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，幸氵壘南宮，遂如廣寧。

translations.literal: On yisi day he favored Lei South Palace and then went to Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day he visited Lei South Palace and then went on to Guangning.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔皇太子率百國以法駕田于東苑，車乘服物皆以乘輿之副。

translations.literal: On jiyou day he ordered the crown prince to lead the hundred states in the imperial carriage hunt at the Eastern Park; chariots, equipage, and regalia were all duplicates of the imperial train.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day he had the crown prince lead the hundred states in an imperial hunt at the Eastern Park, with chariots, dress, and insignia all matching the Son of Heaven's own.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，築平城外郭，周回三十二里。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the outer wall of Pingcheng was built, thirty-two li in circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day they raised Pingcheng's outer rampart, thirty-two li around.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，幸嶠山，遣使者祠黃帝、唐堯廟。

translations.literal: On xinyou day he favored Qiao Mountain and sent envoys to sacrifice at the temples of the Yellow Emperor and Tang Yao.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day he went to Qiao Mountain and sent envoys to offer sacrifice at the temples of the Yellow Emperor and Tang Yao.

sentences.zh: 因東幸幽州，見耆年，問其所苦，賜以爵號。

translations.literal: He then went east to Youzhou, received the aged, asked what afflicted them, and granted titles of rank.
translations.idiomatic: Then he traveled east to Youzhou, met the elders, asked their troubles, and bestowed noble ranks.

sentences.zh: 分遣使者巡行州郡，觀察風俗。

translations.literal: He separately dispatched envoys to tour the provinces and commanderies and observe local customs.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys through the provinces and commanderies to observe local custom.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，車駕還宮，復所過田租之半。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day in the tenth month of winter the imperial carriage returned to the palace and remitted half the field tax along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the tenth month the court returned to the palace and halved the field tax along the way.

sentences.zh: 奚斤等濟河，攻滑台不拔，求濟師，帝怒不許。

translations.literal: Xi Jin and the others crossed the river and attacked Huatai but could not take it; they asked for reinforcements and the Emperor in anger refused.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Jin crossed the river and besieged Huatai without success; when they begged for more troops the Emperor refused in anger.

sentences.zh: 議親南征，為其聲援。

translations.literal: It was debated whether the Emperor should campaign south in person to lend them support.
translations.idiomatic: They debated whether he should lead a southern campaign himself to back them.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，南巡，出自天門關，逾恆嶺，四方蕃附大人各帥所部從者五萬餘人。

translations.literal: On renchen day he toured south, issuing from Heavenly Gate Pass and crossing Mount Heng; great men of the four quarters who had submitted each led their bands, more than fifty thousand followers in all.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day he marched south from Heavenly Gate Pass over Mount Heng; chieftains of the four directions who had submitted each brought their followers, more than fifty thousand in all.

sentences.zh: 十一月，皇太子親統六軍鎮塞上，安定王彌與北新公安同居守。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the crown prince personally commanded the six armies garrisoning the frontier; Prince Anding Mi and Duke of Northern Xin'an An jointly held the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the crown prince took command of the six armies on the frontier while Prince Anding Mi and Duke An of Northern Xin'an held the capital together.

sentences.zh: 丙午，曲赦司州殊死以下。

translations.literal: On bingwu day a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Jizhou, below capital crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day he granted a partial amnesty in Jizhou for all below capital punishment.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，次於中山，問人疾苦。

translations.literal: On bingchen day he halted at Zhongshan and inquired into the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day he stopped at Zhongshan and asked after the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，行幸冀州，存問人俗。

translations.literal: On bingxu day in the twelfth month he traveled to favor Ji Province and comforted the people about their ways of life.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the twelfth month he went to Ji Province and comforted the people in their customs.

sentences.zh: 遣壽光侯叔孫達等率眾自平原東度，徇下青、兗諸郡。

translations.literal: He sent Marquis of Shouguang Shusun Da and others to lead forces east from Pingyuan, subjugating the commanderies of Qing and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Marquis Shusun Da of Shouguang and others east from Pingyuan to overrun Qing and Yan.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月丙辰，行幸鄴，存問人俗。

translations.literal: On bingchen day in the first month of spring in the eighth year he traveled to favor Ye and comforted the people about their ways of life.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the first month of the eighth year he went to Ye and comforted the people in their customs.

sentences.zh: 司空奚斤既平兗、豫，還圍武牢，宋守將毛德祖距守不下。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Xi Jin, having pacified Yan and Yu, returned to besiege Wulao; the Song garrison commander Mao Dezu held fast and could not be dislodged.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Jin, Minister of Works, had pacified Yan and Yu and now besieged Wulao, but the Song defender Mao Dezu held out and would not yield.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕犯塞。

translations.literal: The Rouran raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The Rouran raided the border.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，築長城於長川之南，起自赤城，西至五原，延袤二千餘里，備置戍衛。

translations.literal: On wuchen day in the second month a long wall was built south of the Long River, from Chicheng in the east to Wuyuan in the west, more than two thousand li in extent, with border guards posted throughout.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day in the second month they built a long wall south of the Long River from Chicheng west to Wuyuan, more than two thousand li, with garrisons all along it.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，濟自靈昌。

translations.literal: On yimao day in the third month he crossed from Lingchang.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day in the third month he crossed at Lingchang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，幸成皋，觀武牢。

translations.literal: On dingmao day in the fourth month of summer he favored Chenggao and viewed Wulao.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day in the fourth month he went to Chenggao to view Wulao.

sentences.zh: 而城內乏水，縣綆汲河。

translations.literal: Inside the city water ran short; they lowered ropes to draw from the river.
translations.idiomatic: Water inside the city ran low; they let down ropes to draw from the river.

sentences.zh: 帝令連艦，上施轒巉，絕其汲路；

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered warships linked in chain with battering rams mounted aboard to cut off their drawing route;
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had ships chained together and fitted with assault rams to block their water route;

sentences.zh: 又穿地道，以奪其井。

translations.literal: and also drove tunnels to seize their wells.
translations.idiomatic: and drove tunnels as well to take their wells.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，幸洛陽，觀石經。

translations.literal: On dingchou day he favored Luoyang and viewed the stone classics.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day he went to Luoyang and viewed the stone classics.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁未，還幸河內，北登太行，幸高都。

translations.literal: On dingwei day in the intercalary month he returned to favor Henei, climbed the Taihang north, and favored Gaodu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day in the intercalary month he returned to Henei, crossed the Taihang north, and went to Gaodu.

sentences.zh: 己未，武牢潰。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Wulao fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Wulao fell.

sentences.zh: 士眾大疫，死者十二三。

translations.literal: A great pestilence struck officers and men; one or two in ten died.
translations.idiomatic: A great plague swept the army; ten or twenty percent died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，幸晉陽，班賜王公以下至於廝役。

translations.literal: On xinyou day he favored Jinyang and distributed gifts from the princes and dukes down to the menials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day he went to Jinyang and gave rewards from the princes and dukes down to the servants.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，還次雁門，皇太子率留台王公迎于句注之北。

translations.literal: On bingyin day in the fifth month he returned and halted at Yanmen; the crown prince led the officials who had remained at the capital to welcome him north of Gouzhu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the fifth month he came back to Yanmen; the crown prince led the capital officials to meet him north of Gouzhu.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，車駕至自南巡。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the imperial carriage arrived from the southern tour.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the court returned from the southern tour.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，太尉、宜都公穆觀薨。

translations.literal: On jihai day in the sixth month Grand Marshal and Duke of Yidu Mu Guan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the sixth month Grand Marshal Mu Guan, Duke of Yidu, died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，北巡，至參合陂。

translations.literal: On bingchen day he toured north to Canhe Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day he toured north as far as Canhe Marsh.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，幸三會屋侯泉，詔皇太子率百官以從。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn he favored Sanhui Wuhou Spring and ordered the crown prince to lead the hundred officials in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he went to Sanhui Wuhou Spring and ordered the crown prince to lead the hundred officials after him.

sentences.zh: 八月，幸馬邑，觀於氵壘源。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he favored Mayi and viewed the fishing at Lei Source.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he went to Mayi and watched the fishing at Lei Source.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On yihai day in the ninth month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the ninth month the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，廣西宮，起外牆，周回二十里。

translations.literal: On guimao day in the tenth month of winter the Western Palace was enlarged and an outer wall raised, twenty li in circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day in the tenth month they expanded the Western Palace and built an outer wall twenty li around.

sentences.zh: 是歲饑，詔所在開倉振給。

translations.literal: That year famine struck; an edict ordered granaries opened everywhere for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year there was famine; he ordered granaries opened throughout the realm for relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，帝崩于西宮，時年三十二。

translations.literal: On jisi day in the eleventh month the Emperor died in the Western Palace, aged thirty-two.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day in the eleventh month the Emperor died in the Western Palace at the age of thirty-two.

sentences.zh: 遺詔以司空奚斤所獲軍實賜大臣自司徒長孫嵩以下，至於士卒各有差。

translations.literal: His testament ordered that the military goods taken by Minister of Works Xi Jin be bestowed on the ministers from Minister over the Masses Changsun Song downward and on the soldiers each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: His death edict had the booty Xi Jin had taken distributed to ministers from Minister Changsun Song down and to the soldiers by rank.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，上諡曰明元皇帝，葬于雲中金陵，廟稱太宗。

translations.literal: On gengzi day in the twelfth month his posthumous title was raised as Emperor Mingyuan; he was buried at Jindling in Yunzhong and his temple titled Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the twelfth month he was given the posthumous name Emperor Mingyuan, buried at Jindling in Yunzhong, and his temple called Taizong.

sentences.zh: 帝兼資文武，禮愛儒生，好覽史傳，以劉向所撰《新序》、《說苑》于經典正義多有所闕，乃撰《新集》三十篇，采諸經史，該洽古義云。

translations.literal: The Emperor combined civil and martial gifts, honored Confucian scholars, loved to read histories, and because Liu Xiang's New Prefaces and Garden of Stories left many gaps beside the canonical meanings, he composed New Collectanea in thirty chapters, drawing on the classics and histories to embrace ancient meaning.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was adept in both letters and arms, cherished Confucian scholars, and loved histories; finding Liu Xiang's New Prefaces and Garden of Stories thin beside the canonical tradition, he compiled New Collectanea in thirty chapters from the classics and histories to hold ancient meaning whole.

sentences.zh: 論曰：自古帝王之興，誠有天命，亦賴累功積德，方契靈心。

translations.literal: Commentary: From antiquity the rise of emperors and kings has indeed depended on Heaven's mandate, yet it also rests on accumulated merit and virtue before the numinous heart is won.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Since antiquity the founding of emperors and kings has surely owed something to Heaven's mandate, but also to merit piled generation upon generation before the spirit is moved.

sentences.zh: 有魏奄宅幽方，代為君長。

translations.literal: Wei held the dark north for generations, its chieftains reigning age after age.
translations.idiomatic: Wei possessed the deep north for generations, its lords ruling in succession.

sentences.zh: 神元生自天女，桓、穆勤于晉室，冥符人事，夫豈徒然！

translations.literal: Shenyuan sprang from a heavenly woman; Huan and Mu toiled for the Jin house—these hidden correspondences with human affairs were surely no mere chance!
translations.idiomatic: Shenyuan was born of a heavenly woman; Huan and Mu labored for the Jin court—such secret harmony with human affairs was hardly accident!

sentences.zh: 昭成以雄傑之姿，苞君人之量，征伐四克，威被遐荒。

translations.literal: Zhaocheng with a hero's bearing enclosed a ruler's measure; his campaigns conquered on four sides and his awesomeness reached the far wilderness.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaocheng had the stature of a hero and the breadth of a true king; his wars succeeded on every side and his might reached the distant wilds.

sentences.zh: 乃改都立號，恢隆大業，終百六十載，光宅區中，其原固有由矣。

translations.literal: He then moved the capital and raised his title, restoring the great enterprise; for one hundred sixty years the realm was enlightened—its origins had deep cause indeed.
translations.idiomatic: He changed the capital and raised his title, enlarged the great work, and for one hundred sixty years held the realm in light—the roots of that fortune ran deep.

sentences.zh: 道武顯晦安危之中，屈申潛躍之際。

translations.literal: Daowu showed himself and hid himself amid danger and safety, bent and stretched himself in times of lying low and leaping forth.
translations.idiomatic: Daowu revealed and concealed himself between peril and peace, bowed and rose in seasons of hiding and springing.

sentences.zh: 驅率遺黎，奮其靈武。

translations.literal: He drove and led the remnant people and flung forth his numinous might.
translations.idiomatic: He rallied the scattered people and roused his sacred martial power.

sentences.zh: 克翦方難，遂啟中原。

translations.literal: He cut down square hardship and so opened the Central Plain.
translations.idiomatic: He cleared every obstacle and so unlocked the Central Plain.

sentences.zh: 垂拱人神，顯登皇極。

translations.literal: Hands folded in his sleeves over gods and men, he plainly ascended the supreme pole.
translations.idiomatic: Ruling in ease over gods and men, he openly took the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 雖冠履不暇，棲遑外土，而製作經謨，咸出長久，所謂大人利見，百姓與能，抑不世之神武也。

translations.literal: Though cap and shoes never rested and he wandered anxious in outer lands, his institutions and policies all issued for the long term—the great man favorable in sight, the hundred names sharing his power: was this not a martial spirit unmatched in the age?
translations.idiomatic: Though he seldom rested, cap or shoes, and dwelt uneasy beyond the homeland, what he made and planned was built to endure—the great man seen with favor, the people given strength to follow: was this not a godlike martial gift without peer?

sentences.zh: 而屯厄有期，禍生非慮，將人事不足，豈天實為之乎？

translations.literal: Yet his distress had its term and disaster came unlooked for—was human effort insufficient, or did Heaven in truth ordain it?
translations.idiomatic: Yet hardship had its season and calamity struck unbidden—was the fault in men, or did Heaven truly will it?

sentences.zh: 明元承運之初，屬廓定之始，于時狼顧鴟峙，猶有窺覦。

translations.literal: When Mingyuan first received the mandate, at the hour when the realm was being defined, wolves still looked back and owls still stood guard—many still peered in ambition.
translations.idiomatic: Mingyuan at the start of his reign, when the realm was still being settled, faced wolves glancing back and hawks perched in wait—foes still watched for their chance.

sentences.zh: 已加以天賜之末，內難尤甚。

translations.literal: Then came the closing years of the Heavenly Gift, and inner trouble grew worse yet.
translations.idiomatic: On top of that came the last years of the Heavenly Gift era, and inner strife grew fiercer still.

sentences.zh: 帝孝心睿略，權正兼運，纂業固基，內和外撫，終能周、鄭款服，聲教南被，祖功宗德，其義良已遠矣！

translations.literal: The Emperor's filial heart and keen strategy wielded power and rectitude together; he consolidated the inheritance and strengthened the foundation, harmonized within and pacified without, and in the end won the sincere submission of Zhou and Zheng and spread his transforming renown southward—the ancestral achievement and temple virtue reach far indeed!
translations.idiomatic: With filial devotion, keen wit, and strategy that joined force to justice, he secured the legacy and steadied the base, soothed within and rallied without, until Zhou and Zheng came in good faith and his transforming fame reached south—the merit of ancestors and the glory of the temple stand far indeed!
